findings.title: Required future hosted workflow makes the mandatory full suite fail
findings.description: The committed test_hosted_entrypoint_positive_revision_commands_and_transport unconditionally asserts that .github/workflows/kl074-readiness.yml does not exist. KL-074 must create exactly that file, then run uv run pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider with the full repository suite. That suite collects this harness test and necessarily fails once the required workflow exists. KL-074 cannot edit tests/harness/test_readiness_scope.py under its ratified six-path write scope. The additive hosted workflow therefore remains infeasible as a passing implementation contract despite correct PR-head checkout, local Docker preflight and artifact transport.
findings.required_change: Correct this governance-owned test before merge so both governance absence and the authorized future byte-identical workflow state are accepted, while a present workflow with drift is rejected. Add a meaningful simulated future-state positive regression, rerun selected governance checks, and obtain fresh SHA-bound independent reviews.

review_notes: Fresh independent inspection used committed blobs at the exact reviewed SHA and protected base 822322dfcac69d1042c8f9f7517cecf4903f8163; no prior review conclusions were adopted.

Independently verified exact files_changed against protected-base diff, byte-equivalent preexisting task projections, and all eight selected evidence metadata/log SHA bindings to tested commit b82c41d982547d7f62db18c17385cbeb46b86945. Tested-to-reviewed changes are restricted to HG-037 evidence and governance record.

Independently reran readiness_scope_regressions (63 passed), lint (PASS), typecheck (PASS, 110 source files) and protected-base-to-reviewed diff whitespace check (PASS). Broader review reruns were stopped after the confirmed blocker at coordinator request; they are not claimed PASS. Initial unit rerun used relative PYTHONPATH and encountered a subdirectory import failure, an environment mismatch not classified as a code defect.

The proposed PR event and explicit head-SHA checkout provide a prospective pre-merge execution route, supported by official GitHub event documentation; existing CI files are outside the diff. The unconditional workflow-absence assertion defeats the mandated full-suite oracle on that route.

KL-074 remains NOT_STARTED with empty requirement/evidence projections and ten prospective NOT_RUN checks. Governance/test approval cannot claim actual image causality, hosted execution, task/product/release PASS or production activation.
